summary: Compares Binance's 7 trading-bot archetypes (spot-grid / futures-grid / spot-dca / smart-portfolio / futures-arbitrage / futures-algo-orders / auto-invest) against a market regime classification. Recommends best bot per scenario, scores each bot's expected fit, and emits config templates ready to be turned into runtime configurations.
core_logic: Classify the regime from inputs.market_regime (one of: ranging, trending_up, trending_down, high_volatility) — or auto-detect from supplied klines.
For each of 7 bot archetypes, look up the regime-fitness table; produce a 0-100 score.
Generate a parameter template per bot tuned to the regime + capital.
Recommend the top-3 bots; flag risk constraints (account drawdown limit, leverage cap).
recommended_next_step: Pick a bot config and run it through runtime.bots simulator (forthcoming) before live deployment.
